additional_info.body:
Dear Theo,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charger, we indeed see that outlet 2 is unavailable as a request from the customer side.
We have checked multiple days to check for the error, and see that the last error was on 16/02, which was the following:
This is a communication log where the charger logs the cable temperature.
Right now we can`t see if the error is still appearing as the outlet has been set on unavailable since 19/02.
We are only able to act on a live error of the charger, which is not the case at this moment.
No error flags are appearing.
Please provide us with feedback.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0479914-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/R5170001865] Connector No.2 – Temp Error CRM:03209000242
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The outlet is set to unavailable because after some temperature errors vehicles have been soldered to the connector because of heat.
Without a written statement from SIEMENS asking us to unlock the connector we won’t risk the deterioration of another one of our client cars.
Please analyze this issue that as a reminder happened regularly during the last month :
Anyway, you won’t be able to see the error “live” as it only happens during some charging sessions and it ends the session and disappear right after.
Please deal with this subject as seriously as the major risk it concerns for our clients.
Kind regards.
Théo  SALMON
Chargé d’exploitation IRVE
ENGIE Mobilités Electriques
theo.salmon@engie.com
+33 6 81 41 18 59

Following the update, i send this ticket regarding temp sensor to L3.

There is no live error in the error flags as this error only happens during the charging sessions.

Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0479914
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R5 170001865

M8i3IC
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Please inspect the outlet 2 cable. I suspect a mal function on PT1000 inside the CCS plug.
See the case:
Session stop normally
Temperature reported on the ecog
After 10 seconds and after the car is disconnected, the outlet turns out of order due temp sensor
Please confirm if the cable sensor is really defective and replace the cable if needed.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
